status: pre-registered; no blend has been scored on any split
what_was_already_seen: Both components' test results (PLAN.md steps 5-6). The two blends below were named in PLAN.md step 7 before either was scored; this file fixes their exact definitions and the decision rule.

inputs.tabicl: build/modal_result_esm64.json scores (zero-shot TabICLv2, 117 features, headline run)
inputs.join: row-for-row on the test split; apo_id, chain, seq_id and label asserted identical

rank.definition: 0.5 * r_tabicl + 0.5 * r_s2p, where r is the within-protein percentile rank: scipy.stats.rankdata(score, method='average') / n_residues_in_protein

nothing_fitted: Weights are fixed at 0.5 / 0.5. No parameter is chosen on any data.

metrics.result: AUC and AUPRC, per protein (mean over proteins) and pooled, on CB-full (231) and CB-P2RANK-apo (184)
metrics.approximate_only: TPR, FPR, MCC, F1_weighted at 'flag the top 7.74 % of each protein' (the rank rule frozen on CV for TabICL in operating_point/frozen.json); labelled approximate because that operating point was not chosen for a blend

comparisons: Paired bootstrap over proteins, same resample for every arm: blend minus s2p alone, and blend minus TabICL alone. 10,000 resamples per-protein, 2,000 pooled, seed 0.

decision_rule_for_step_8.primary: rank blend minus s2p alone, per-protein AUPRC on CB-full: paired 95 % CI entirely above zero
decision_rule_for_step_8.secondary: prob blend minus s2p alone, pooled AUPRC on CB-P2RANK-apo: paired 95 % CI entirely above zero
decision_rule_for_step_8.consequence: If either passes, out-of-fold stacking (step 8) is proposed for the user's go-ahead. If neither passes, it is not proposed. Two tests are run; that is stated with the result.
